description:
Mail with the password or OAuth token off the heap - sending (SMTP) and
    receiving (IMAP, POP3). seclume connects, encrypts with its own TLS 1.3
    and logs in with PLAIN, XOAUTH2 or the protocol's own login written from
    native memory; Jakarta Mail gets the logged-in connection under the
    standard protocol names of a session seclume sets up, and never holds the
    credential. Works with Spring's JavaMailSender, Spring Integration and
    Camel through that session.
